title: smooth cotton too thin, not reversable (1 star), BUT quilted is great, reversable (4.5 stars)
text:
smooth cotton too thin, not reversable (1 star), BUT quilted is great, reversable (4.5 stars). UGH!! Well, this is awkward. There are a couple of different styles of placemats on this page. QUILTED cotton and SMOOTH cotton, and cant do separate reviews for them. I have them both. One I like and find of good quality (and have more in my wish list), and the other I am entirely disappointed with. How to rate? So please read on for more info on each.

I had actually initially reviewed a set of navy quilted cotton that are reversable. I use them daily, and have been considering a set in the red. I like those a lot. I had reviewed them saying as such (which I will include below). Then when this set of "citrus paisley" placemats (smooth cotton, scallop edge) became available I got them because they match a [[ASIN:B07TTHG75M set of Vera Bradley dish towels]] I have in same pattern. Didn't realize that they would be in the same listing, and because I already reviewed one, I couldnt review the other. I have enough to say about this new set that I am redoing the review to include info on both.

The quilted is great. This cotton? not so much. It is paper thin. Reminds me more of a linen napkin than a placemat. I am considering using it as a napkin! Nah, I mean it will work for the most part as a placemat, but it is SO thin and light. JUst not at all what I expected. Double the thickness and then it is a placemat. I think it will move around too easy. Would work as a decorative piece of material. I dont know.. I am just not pleased with these, especially for price especially compared to the quilted. If this were pack of 6? Maybe. I expected much better quality and heft. These are more dainty than what they should be. Love the color. ALSO? definitely not reversable. They need to take that out of the title. They are pretty on one side, then washed out on the other. NOPE NOPE NOPE. FAIL!
1 star

BUT, if you are looking at the QUILTED placemats? Those are delightful, and reversable. Here is my review that I had originally written for that: 4.5 stars

"Can't go wrong with simply elegant Vera Bradley placemats, lovely design & color, lays well
--Beautifully done place mats. Has the lofty quilted feel familiar to other Vera Bradley goods. I am enjoying the versatile use of these soft mats, they are pleasant enough to look at all day long. Use them under a place setting, or even as a decorative mat. We tend to eat on the couch, and place food on the coffee table. I use place mats to help protect the table from heat and food dribbles. The colors are all so pleasant, and reversable. Nice stitching, lays well, looks simply elegant.
--I have this set in Java Navy Camo, and it is just so appealing. It reminds me of paisely even though it isn't. Hopefully more colors and designs are forthcoming."

SO, how to rate? I am going with 2 stars.
